purpose: SOUTH WALK 3-frame animation REPLACEMENT (walk_south_1/2/3.png) — new source art, same landmark-matching methodology as the previous south_walk_build_meta.json batch. south_idle.png/south_attack*/defense are explicitly NOT touched by this batch.
processing: Non-generative only -- no AI redraw/regeneration/compositing/mirroring. Each source already carried a genuine straight (non-premultiplied) alpha channel with no white-background fringe (checked by bucketing edge pixels by alpha and confirming brightness does not climb toward white as alpha drops), so unlike the previous south-walk batch, no color un-premultiply step was needed. One deterministic step per image: landmark-based scale+anchor onto the existing shared 700x920 boss canvas, matching the SAME target constants the previous south_walk_build_meta.json batch established (this batch replaces that art, not the target sizing).
landmark_method: head_top_y/head_center_x found by scanning alpha>10 within columns x >= 40% of native image width (excludes the wing, which sits left-of-center in this pose) for the topmost contiguous opaque row and that row's horizontal center; verified visually per-frame by marking the computed point on the source image and confirming it lands on the crown of the head, not a wing feather tip. feet_bottom_y is the single lowest opaque row overall (a foot/claw tip), matching the previous batch's convention.

targets_reused_from_previous_batch.note: Same targets as south_walk_build_meta.json (the batch this one replaces) -- keeps this batch's apparent on-canvas size identical to the pre-replacement south walk art, per instruction to match the previous images' look.

placement_formula: paste_x = round(TARGET_CENTER_X - head_center_x*scale); paste_y = round(TARGET_FEET_BOTTOM_Y - feet_bottom_y*scale); pasted onto a fresh transparent 700x920 canvas. No clipping needed for any of the 3 frames (all fit within [0,700]x[0,920] after placement).

verification_on_final_canvas.method: Re-measured head_top_y/head_center_x on the FINAL 700x920 canvas using the same x>=245px (~35% of canvas width) column exclusion, and feet_bottom_y as the overall lowest opaque row.
verification_on_final_canvas.note: All three land within 1px of TARGET_CENTER_X/TARGET_FEET_BOTTOM_Y and within 1px of each other on head_top_y -- no per-frame jump in size, position, or foot anchor.

in_game_scale: All three files continue to use the existing SOUTH_WALK_SCALE (1.10) render-time multiplier applied uniformly in drawBoss() -- unchanged, not touched by this batch.
animation_wiring: bossFrameName() now cycles walk_south_1 -> walk_south_2 -> walk_south_3 -> walk_south_2 -> walk_south_1 -> ... (ping-pong, period 4: [1,2,3,2]) while boss.moving and facing south, via `[1,2,3,2][Math.floor(now / WALK_FRAME_PERIOD_MS) % 4]`. WALK_FRAME_PERIOD_MS itself is unchanged. NORTH/EAST/WEST keep their original wrap-around cycles untouched.
south_idle_explicitly_untouched: south_idle.png is NOT updated by this batch (explicit instruction) -- it remains the old walk_south_1 image from the previous batch, so IDLE<->WALK now has a small, expected visual seam on the very first walk frame; this is intentional per this batch's scope, not an oversight.
dark_phase_exclusion: Unchanged -- DARK PHASE never draws south_idle/walk_south_* (see drawBossDarkPhase()).
